title: Quick Roasted Portuguese Fettuccine Pasta
description: A roasted and crumbly post-workout Portuguese dish featuring fettuccine and a mirepoix base, Whole30 friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the chopped onion, carrots, and celery with 1 tbsp of olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the vegetables in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the vegetables are roasting, cook the fettuccine according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil over medium high heat and add the chicken breast, cooking until browned and cooked through.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cooked fettuccine to the skillet, tossing to combine with the chicken and garlic.
Once the vegetables are done roasting, add them to the skillet and toss to combine with the fettuccine and chicken.
